scope.summary: Implement a live on-canvas annotator for stroke + gradient editing (draggable weight, dash, arrowhead, gradient-stop, and gradient-geometry handles) whose every manipulation maps to a typed value edit so the same change is reproducible via the model command surface; the annotator is toggleable/hideable without losing the underlying values.
acceptance_criteria: live annotator maps every drag to typed reproducible edit; toggleable without value loss; author_ids + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: live annotator reachable + toggleable via author_id
test: each handle drag emits typed value edit reproducible by command; toggle hides annotator without value loss

target_entries: Studio / Vector / On-canvas stroke & gradient annotator

risk_if_missed: No on-canvas stroke/gradient editing; handle edits not reproducible by model.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
